card.name: Yearly or weekly recurrence words
card.fires_on: Recurrence words like "year" after "every" or "each" after a time phrase, as in "every year" or "same day each week". Also a comma after a yearly time such as "Each May".

modes.label: Every year

modes.description: The word "each" following a day or verb, before week or year.

modes.label: Comma after yearly time
modes.description: A comma after a month that opens a recurring event sentence.
